translations.text: The judgment against Nineveh, in the book of the visions of Nahum the Elkoshite.
The Lord is a jealous and avenging God. The Lord takes vengeance in anger. The Lord takes vengeance on those who hate him and reserves his anger for his enemies.
The Lord is slow to anger and great in power, and he certainly does not acquit the guilty. The Lord's way is in the whirlwind and the storm, and the clouds are the dust beneath his feet.
He rebukes the sea and dries it up, and he makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel mourn, and the growth of Lebanon withers.
The mountains trembled before him, and the hills dissolved. The earth shook before him—the world and all its inhabitants.
Who can stand before his anger? Who can endure his burning wrath? His fury burns like fire, and the mountains melt before him.
The Lord is good, giving help in the day of distress, and he knows those who trust in him.
With a flood he brings complete destruction; he will sweep through its place, and darkness will pursue his enemies.
What are you plotting against the Lord? He brings complete destruction, and distress will not arise twice.
For they are rebellious, even their rulers, and drunk with their drunkenness. They are devoured and completely consumed like dry stubble.
From you will come someone who plots evil against the Lord and devises injustice.
Thus says the Lord concerning the heads of the many waters that flowed and passed away: Though I afflicted you, I will not afflict you again.
Now I will break his yoke from you and cut your bonds.

The Lord will issue a command concerning you: no more descendants bearing your name will be sown. In the house of your god I will destroy the carved and cast images, and I will quickly make it your grave.

Look! On the mountains are the feet of the messenger bringing good news and proclaiming peace. Celebrate your festivals, Judah, and fulfill your vows, because the evildoer will no longer commit injustice among you; he has been utterly destroyed.
A leader has come up before you. He keeps watch, watches the road, braces his waist, and is very strong in power.
For I am restoring the glory of Jacob like the glory of Israel, because tramplers have trampled them and ruined their branches.
The shields of their warriors are red, and the mighty men play with fiery torches and chariots on the day they prepare, while the horsemen are thrown into confusion.
They boast [?] in their chariots and show off. They look like torches and run like lightning.
They will seize their rulers and stumble as they walk. They will hurry to the wall and prepare [?].
The gates of Judah were opened, and the palace shook.
She stationed her horsemen and went up, while her slave women moaned in their hearts like doves.
Nineveh is like a lake of water; she is a reservoir. Yet they are fleeing. “Stop! Stop!” But no one turns back.
Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold! There is no end to her adornments; all her precious vessels are strong.
She is trampled, overthrown, and broken apart. The heart is broken, knees give way, every waist trembles, and all their faces are black like soot on a pot.
Where is the lioness's lair, the feeding place of the lioness's cub, where the lion went in, along with the lion's cub, with no one to frighten them?
The lion tore apart enough food for his cubs and also cut up food for his [?]. He filled his dens and his lair with prey.

Look, I am against you, says the Lord Almighty. I will destroy your troops in smoke, and the sword will devour your cubs. I will wipe out your plunder from the earth, and the voice of your servants will no longer be heard.
Woe to the city of blood, entirely deceitful and full of injustice! Plunder never leaves it.
The crack of the whip, the sound of rattling wheels, a galloping horse, and a bouncing chariot!
A charging horseman, a flashing sword, a glittering spear, a multitude of slain, and heaps of corpses! There is no end to the corpses; they stumble over their dead bodies.
This is because of the many acts of prostitution of the beautiful prostitute, the mistress of sorcery, who seduces nations through her prostitution and families through her sorcery.
Look, I am against you, says the Lord Almighty. I will lift your skirts over your face and show your nakedness to the nations and your shame to the kingdoms.
I will throw filth on you, disgrace you, and make you a spectacle.
Everyone who sees you will flee from you and say, “Nineveh has been plundered! Who will grieve for you? Where shall I seek a comforter for you?”
Are you better than Thebes, the city of Amon, which sits among the rivers, surrounded by water, whose strength was the sea and whose wall was water?
Cush and Egypt were her strength, without limit. The people of Put and Libya were her helpers.
Yet she too went into captivity. Her infants were dashed to pieces at the head of every street. They cast lots for her honored men, and all her nobles were bound in chains.
You too will become sick and be despised. You too will seek help against your enemies.
All your fortresses are like fig trees with early figs: when they ripen, they fall into the eater’s mouth.
Your people within you are like women. The gates of your land will be opened to your enemies, and fire will consume your gate bars.
Store up water for yourself for the siege, and strengthen your fortresses. Go into the mud and tread the clay; strengthen the [?].
There fire will consume you, and the sword will destroy you. It will consume you like caterpillars, because you grew strong like caterpillars and multiplied like locusts.
You have multiplied your merchants far beyond the stars of heaven. The locust plunders and flies away.
Your princes are like locusts, and your warriors are like locusts clinging to a hedge on a cold day. When the sun rises, they depart, and their whereabouts are unknown.
Your companions have fallen asleep, kings of Assyria, and your close relatives have settled down. Your people are scattered over the mountains, with no one to gather them.
No one grieves over your ruin; your wound is painful. All who hear the news about you clap their hands over you, because your wickedness has continually swept over everyone.
